description: Register a new API key against a USDC, USDT, BTC, or USDT-TRC20 payment the caller has already sent (no auth required, no email). This tool does not move funds: it submits the transaction hash. Receiving addresses: EVM 0xAd982CB19aCCa2923Df8F687C0614a7700255a23, Solana 6a1mLjefhvSJX1sEX8PTnionbE9DqoYjU6F6bNkT4Ydr, Tron TC5yvwkAMakkXtUxYiu2Yn1xbBcwYuD6cn, Bitcoin bc1qg7qnerdhlmdn899zemtez5tcx2a2snc0dt9dt0 (1 confirmation required). USDC/USDT auto-detected from the transaction; BTC converted to USD at market rate. One key per wallet; existing keys are topped up with a credit purchase instead. Non-refundable. Current prices and volume discounts: https://insumermodel.com/pricing/

amount.description: Stablecoin amount sent (minimum 5). Not required for BTC — USD value derived from on-chain amount at market rate.

appName.description: Name for the API key (e.g. your agent or app name)

chainId.description: Payment chain: 1, 8453, 137, 42161, 10, 56, 43114, 'solana', 'bitcoin', or 'tron'. EVM/Solana accept USDC and USDT (auto-detected). Bitcoin accepts BTC (converted to USD at market rate). Tron accepts USDT-TRC20.
